scope: Scheduling proof only. No UNKNOWN s4 class is promoted to LOSS and no solver verdict is inferred.

proof.statement: Closing any one of the three repair classes as LOSS forces the exact minimum additional class count from 3 to 2 under the same finite snapshot.
proof.upper_bound: The other two repair classes cover every still-unsecured root vertex not covered by the newly closed class, so two additional classes suffice.
proof.lower_bound: Removing the newly secured unit-weight dual vertex leaves two unit dual weights. Every usable class has total dual weight at most 1 by the independently audited dual certificate, so at least two additional classes are necessary.
proof.conclusion: Each repair class has the same certified one-unit cover decrement on successful LOSS closure.

priority_consequence.claim: 92 versus 99 is a strict reduction in unresolved canonical s5 boundary count for the same certified 3-to-2 cover decrement. It is not a claim that solver node cost is 7.07% lower.
